name.km: ចំហុយទឹកខ្មៅងាវ

description: Steamed over fermented black beans, garlic and chili.
descriptionKm: ចំហុយជាមួយទឹកខ្មៅ — សណ្ដែកខ្មៅ ខ្ទឹមស និងម្ទេស។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងចំហុយ

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាតសំបក

ingredients.itemKm: សណ្ដែកខ្មៅជ្រក់
ម្ទេសស្រស់

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.textKm: រៀបចំងាវ៖ សម្អាតសំបក។

instructions.text: Arrange on a heatproof plate and scatter over the aromatics.
Steam over rapidly boiling water until the shells open.
instructions.tip: Don't over-steam — pull it the moment it is just cooked to keep it tender.

instructions.text: Drizzle over the sauce, top with the fresh garnish, and serve with rice.
